# Quora

7 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 7 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Quora question and answer data: question search and detail, answer search, Space post search, profile search, and Space/topic search. A useful long-tail source for buying-intent and troubleshooting language that never reaches Reddit.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/quora/answers - 5 credits (advanced)

Search Quora answers

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.

Returns Quora answers matching a keyword, including the answer text, author name and credential, upvotes, views, and the parent question title.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example learn programming. · e.g. `learn programming`
- `time` (optional, enum: all | hour | day | week | month | year) - Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/answers?query=learn programming" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/quora/post - 5 credits (advanced)

Get a Quora question

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns one Quora question from its URL: title, body text, and published date. Quora questions rarely have a separate body; content.text is the title. For written answers call GET /v1/quora/answers with a keyword.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Quora question, for example https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-alternative-to-SendGrid-Email-API. · e.g. `https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-alternative-to-SendGrid-Email-API`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/post?url=https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-alternative-to-SendGrid-Email-API" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/quora/posts - 5 credits (advanced)

Search Quora space posts

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.

```bash

  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/quora/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Search Quora questions

**Cost** 5 credits (advanced) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.

Returns Quora questions matching a keyword: title, URL, answer count, follower count, and publish time. Filter by recency with time. For written answers to a topic call GET /v1/quora/answers with the same query.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example learn programming. · e.g. `learn programming`
- `time` (optional, enum: all | hour | day | week | month | year) - Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/search?query=learn programming" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
